items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... My uncle. Doce Bonetta. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Ori? Yes. Yeah, Ori always did use the slide, since I started with Ori.

ctx.x: Yeah, a couple of them should play sometimes. He played with the Little Tuxedo Brass Band. He kept on working. Yeah, he'd play in the Brass Band like that. And catch a job like that he'd play.

Who was the first one really to play the slide trombone, as you say? Your uncle was the first one to do? My uncle. Doce Bonetta. Before that, they used mostly vowels. Vowels, that's all. When you were playing with Ori, was he playing slide or valve? Who? Kid Ori. Was that the other way? Ori always did use the slide, didn't he?
Ori? Yes. Yeah, Ori always did use the slide, since I started with Ori.
